newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch transport ministry investigates low-flying.
newsitem.headline: Dutch transport ministry investigates low-flying.

text.p: The Dutch Ministry of Transport is investigating an incident where an El Al freighter was flown just 260 metres over Amsterdam, said the Ministry's civil aviation spokesman, Toon van Wyk.
The Israeli airline's all-cargo Boeing 747 freighter was coming into land on Sunday, October 27 at 8.30pm, when it flew over the IJtunnel, north of Amsterdam, at 260 metres.
"It should have been flying at double that altitude or more," he said.
Air traffic control requested the carrier to take another approach and around 400 residents in the area had complained, he added.

Van Wyk said he expected the results of the investigation in a few days but he said that the pilot of the aircraft will probably have to pay a fine. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
